chunks: From him, from al-‘Abbās ibn ‘Āmir, from Abū al-Mi‘zā, from Samā‘ah, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:
It is not appropriate for a young woman to go out to the funeral in order to perform salat over it, unless she is a woman who has entered into old age.

key_terms.الْجِنَازَةِ: the funeral or bier of the deceased
key_terms.تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهَا: to perform salat over it, meaning funeral prayer
key_terms.لَيْسَ يَنْبَغِي: it is not fitting or appropriate; indicates disapproval in this legal context

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a young woman to go out for funeral salat in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning attendance of women at a funeral salat. It states that a young woman should not go out for the funeral, while making an exception for an elderly woman.
